Membership basis after the main rebase

420 reruns: 105 US stock tests with all 25 requested quarterly/end-date membership snapshots; 105 India stock tests with incomplete dated snapshots; 210 static ETF controls. All 52,240 trades pass ledger and zero-volume fill checks.

US PIT is quarterly snapshot coverage, not exact daily index-change history. 75 US stock symbols lack prices. India has four membership observation gaps of at least 180 days, up to 648 days, plus 104 symbols without prices. India results are not complete PIT. Completed status does not certify complete data. ETF baskets are static surviving funds, not PIT universe tests.

Source, execution & data warnings
Research adaptations, not exact publisher portfolios. Incomplete index membership and surviving ETF baskets remain limitations.
Provisional = early history-end sale at last available quote. India ETF fees are approximate. US signal exits fill next close; India next open.
Monthly rotation exits at month end, one session before new entries. It is not the source's synchronized next-open rotation. Do not compare this as an exact original replication.
